title: A LIGHTWEIGHT AUTOENCODER MODEL FOR EPILEPTIC SEIZURE DETECTION

abstract: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder marked by recurrent and unpredictable disturbances in brain activity, leading to epileptic seizures (ES). One approach of diagnosing these seizures involves analyzing ElectroEncephaloGraphic (EEG) …
